scoring_justification: Cannot recompute from raw trajectories; only aggregated CSVs are submitted. Compare agent's reported values to paper-derived gold using tolerances and structural checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for transition temperatures T0* and chain probabilities P1, and analytic model parameters for energy ratio verification.
hidden_assets.generation_method: T0* directly from paper text; P1 approximated from paper's Figure 8 with tolerance of ±0.1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, and the analytic model (Eq.13) is the exact formula from the paper. The reference solver will produce outputs that match these gold values.

outputs.description: Normalized average potential energy ratio. Checked against reference values within tolerance.
Characteristic structural transition temperature for each cluster size. Checked within tolerance.
Probability of a single simple virtual chain at T*=0.71. Checked against reference within tolerance.
Radial distribution function G(r) for the central atom of a 6-atom cluster at T*=0.46. First peak location and height, and plateau value are checked.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are numerically verifiable against paper-reported curves with appropriate tolerances. No gold values are disclosed here.

steps.description: Check normalized potential energy ratio matches the virtual chains model prediction (Eq.13) with the paper's T0* values within tolerance 0.1.
Check T0* values match paper's best-fit (0.340,0.350,0.380,0.417) within ±0.02.
Check P1 values match paper's Fig.8 within ±0.1.
Check RDF of g=6 cluster: first peak near r*≈1.0, height≈1.5, plateau in [2,3] ≈0.2-0.3.
